title: Darius Dale: 2027 Should Be a “Great Year for Bitcoin” as Fed Rate Cuts Come
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Darius Dale: 2027 Should Be a “Great Year for Bitcoin” as Fed Rate Cuts Come Darius Dale, Founder & CEO of 42 Macro, joins BMTV to answer whether the Fed is making a policy mistake with a December rate hike priced in. This post Darius Dale: 2027 Should Be a “Great Year for Bitcoin” as Fed Rate Cuts Come first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
